phase: Add staging marker-initialization tooling (init-marker.sh) and document the marker workflow. init-marker.sh performs pre-write fail-closed guards (explicit STAGING_ENV_ID, allowlist membership, production rejection) before any write; then existence check with conflict-stop (existing marker reused only if staging===true and envId matches; mismatch stops without overwrite); then additive insert of the fixed doc (collection 'staging', _id 'staging', staging:true, envId, createdAt, purpose); then verify re-read. Commands are JSON-built via node to avoid shell-escaping defects. README updated with marker contract + init usage. No business logic change; no production target.
